summary: First-pass e2e testing of ShopKart ecommerce MVP. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed covering auth (register/login/me/logout, admin), products (CRUD, filters, sort, categories, 400/404 errors), cart (add/update/remove/clear, auth, invalid product), and orders (checkout with free/paid shipping, empty-cart 400, per-user isolation, admin/orders RBAC). Frontend: home page loads with hero + 4 category tiles; register & login work and populate account menu; admin can log in and seed 6 demo products via admin panel; customer can browse /products, filter by category (Electronics 3/6), add product to cart (badge -> 1), open cart (subtotal $39.50), increment qty, checkout with mock payment and receive order-confirmation with SK-XXXXXXXXXX number (SK-BD47DA930C); orders page shows the placed order; cart badge returns to 0 (cart emptied). Math verified: 2 × $39.50 = $79.00 subtotal, 8% tax $6.32, free shipping (>$35), total $85.32 matches UI.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfiguration risk: backend/.env sets CORS_ORIGINS="*" while backend enables allow_credentials=True. Starlette will still emit Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * which browsers reject for credentialed requests. Currently works only because the preview domain calls same origin; in a split-domain production deployment this will break auth. Recommend using explicit origin list (e.g. https://shop-engine-57.preview.emergentagent.com).
Auth cookies are set with secure=False and samesite=lax. For a production HTTPS deployment secure should be True (and consider samesite=none if cross-site).
CheckoutInput.address is typed as raw dict; consider a Pydantic address model with required fields (name, street, city, state, zip, country) to validate at API layer.
server.py is a single 500+ line module. Consider splitting into routers (auth, products, cart, orders, admin) and a services layer as the app grows.
Cart persistence: cart items are stored keyed only by user_id; guest carts are not supported (blocked by auth requirement, matches product decision but worth noting).
test_credentials: Admin: admin@shop.com / admin123 (seeded). Test customers registered dynamically with TEST_/customer_/buyer2_ prefixes (email + Test1234).
seed_data_creation: 6 demo products seeded via admin panel 'Add 6 demo products' button (Weekend Tote Bag, The Everything Shopping Guide, Modern Smartphone 128GB, JBL Bluetooth Headphones, Google Nest Mini, Sony WH-1000XM5). Multiple TEST_ prefixed users/orders were created during pytest run (tests clean up their own products; user/order docs remain in DB with TEST_ prefix for identification).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All primary flows are green. Note that sort-select on /products is a shadcn Select (button+popover), not a native <select>; use click + option-role selectors if you need to test sort ordering via UI (backend sort was already verified via pytest for price_asc, price_desc, rating). TEST_ prefixed data (users/products/orders) may still exist in the DB and can be cleaned by dropping documents where email/title/user starts with TEST_.
